newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Astra falls in New York.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Astra falls in New York.

text.p: Swedish drug company Astra Ab fell Wednesday to highlight trade in American Depositary Receipts (ADRs).
Astra was down one to 38-7/8 at midday after J.P. Morgan analyst Mark Becker cut his rating on the stock to market perform from buy.
Trading in Astra was heavy at 1.7 million shares. It was among the most active among ADRs. Astra on Monday reported lower-than-expected first quarter earnings.
Philips Electronics NV rose 2-7/8 to 50-1/2 after the Dutch company reported first quarter earnings that surpassed expectations.

Network equipment supplier Madge Networks Inc fell 1-5/8 to five after reporting a first quarter loss of $0.11 a share, against a profit of $0.06 a year earlier. Madge's headquarters are in the Netherlands.
Madge reported its earnings following the market's close Tuesday. Oppenheimer & Co today its rating on the stock to market perform from market outperform, market sources said.
Oil ADRs largely eased. Royal Dutch Petroleum Co fell 2-1/4 to 178-5/8 and British Petroleum Co Plc was off one to 138-7/8.
Brazilian telephone company Telebras SA rose 1-1/4 to 111-1/8.
Decliners led advancers 253 to 216 among 806 ADRs. The ADR group was up 0.01 percent in early afternoon and volume was 47 million shares.
